verdict.rationale: Fathom documents non-interactive programmatic access: API keys generated in settings authenticate all REST resources, and official TypeScript and Python SDKs handle auth, pagination, and rate-limit retries, so scripts can pull meeting data without the UI. The docs never frame this as headless or CI execution of the product, and there is no CLI or CI guidance. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI usage documentation, an official CLI, service-account or non-user credentials for pipelines, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website's settings area.
They handle authentication, pagination, error handling, and all the complex stuff so you can focus on building amazing integrations.
The official SDKs automatically retry rate-limited requests, waiting for the duration indicated by the `Retry-After` header.
You can use this SDK in a Python shell with uv and the `uvx` command
